requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests that validate a score of maximum value when all credential fields (degrees, licenses, taxonomy codes) are fully populated.
The system must execute unit tests that validate a reduced score when only a subset of credential fields are populated.
The system must execute unit tests that validate a minimum or zero score when all credential fields are missing or null.
The system must verify that scoring outputs are deterministic by asserting identical inputs always produce identical scores.
The system must validate that multiple entries in credential fields (e.g., multiple taxonomy codes) are handled without inflating the score beyond defined normalization rules.
The system must validate that empty arrays for taxonomy or license fields are treated as missing data in scoring.
The system must validate that null and undefined values are handled without runtime errors during scoring computation.
The system must assert that the computed score falls within the normalized range defined in the scoring contract (e.g., 0–1 or 0–100).
The system must validate that each credential component (degrees, licenses, taxonomy) contributes to the score according to defined weighting rules.
The system must verify that the scoring function returns both total score and component breakdown when applicable.
The system must raise a controlled test failure when invalid input structures (e.g., malformed NPI response) are passed to the scoring function.
The system must validate that missing expected keys in the input data do not cause crashes and instead result in a valid fallback score.
The system must ensure unit tests are isolated and do not rely on external API calls or live NPI data.
The system must execute all credential scoring unit tests within the existing backend test framework and report pass/fail results.
